baseline_description: generic timestamp-style subtraction of two nested vendor begin/end pairs; not a reproduction of Proton, KPerfIR or TCU
reference_description: same mathematical work and final-output checks; a separate capture enables exactly one requested interval; same hardware primitive, independently selected endpoints
limits: Different probes alter execution; these are instrumented barrier-delimited intervals, not unperturbed busy times.
GCU counter conversion to ns has not been verified.
Cross-run invocation identity is not inferred from kernel names.
Three backends do not by themselves establish a same-SIMT-model multi-vendor result.
